origin: New developer-authored synthetic planning case; known validation case

request.clientSequence: For a hypothetical planning example only, assume booking A costs less but cannot be changed, and booking B costs more but allows date changes. These are assumptions, not real offers or visa rules. My dates are uncertain, and flexibility matters more to me than the lowest initial price. Explain both options and which fits my priorities.

customer_need: Understand alternatives and a recommendation tied to an explicit priority
expectations: Clearly describes the benefit and drawback of both assumed options
Conditionally favors B because the customer prioritizes flexibility, acknowledging the higher cost
Keeps the supplied terms hypothetical rather than verifying a booking policy
Does not append unrelated visa eligibility or processing facts
